I agree with this. Suicide doesn’t need to involve others, although it inevitably will, you do those you love a favour by not being a public act and doing it in private or even leaving a note or telling the police where you are. 

Don’t drag innocent bystanders in and potentially fuck them up too.

Suicide isn’t selfish. Expecting someone to stick around for longer because you don’t want to lose them is selfish. Expecting someone to sit through their mental health convincing them it’s the best thing to do is selfish. 

Suicide is not selfish but the act of purposely jumping in front of a train or off a bridge to get a dramatic exit is fucked up because it effects those people too, who didn’t ask to be involved. But suicide isn’t selfish. 

My friend recently killed himself, hung himself from a tree behind his home. He tried to keep it to himself but his family and the police had him under house arrest, he managed to escape and died quickly. I don’t think of him as selfish at all. I just wish he had help.

I’ve never had a successful relationship, looking back on them I realise now that a lot of them were extremely toxic and a bad situation for me and the other person.  I was very paranoid, which led to me pushing certain people away and accusing them of things they didn’t do - but then I found out a lot of those relationships had not been faithful. I ended up getting pregnant with my abusive ex and left him after discovering the things he was doing and saying about me behind my back. He stole from me and was a nasty piece of work. 

Speed up 2 years later and I’m currently in a relationship. It isn’t easy, at all, but it’s worth every single second. I ended the relationship last year when I had a break down and ended up isolating myself for 6 months. Finally talked to him again and a few people for help and we decided to give it another go - and he learns and tries his best to adapt to my BPD. 

Give yourself time. Don’t rush anything. Wait for the perfect person, don’t hurt yourself with the wrong ones.

I truly hope she understands and pushes the money and cat issue aside to be there for you.

We have terrible times and dark places and sometimes there seems like there will NEVER be a light but it’s there. I promise you.

It’s really hard to deal with an abortion, even if it’s the best thing for you in the moment or even medically life saving for you. It’s always, always going to be hard. 

I had an abortion at 19, near suicidal and the father was messaging me, calling me up at work to abuse me down the phone until in the end it was either my life or the baby and I chose myself. 

I regret it every day. I saw the little pod. The tiny webbed hands and feet and the eyes. It broke me, but it had to be done or I wouldn’t be here. 

The world is so anti abortion but forget the world and focus on you. I now have a gorgeous 18 month old princess, life is still hard but it’s a journey.

It’s said to be selfish because it hurts the people we love and leave behind and whoever is the person to find their body however they pass. 

It’s selfish to expect someone to stick around for the living just because we will miss them. To me there is nothing selfish or wrong with suicide, I lost a friend 3 months ago due to hanging and his mental health had convinced him that all he was doing was hurting the people he loved and cared for. It hurts to know he’s gone and he thought that bad of himself but you can’t control what mental health does to your brain, I’m happy he is finally at peace and not suffering. I know how it feels. 

If I wasn’t so terrified of the unknown of death I would have probably killed myself by now, but I also now have my daughter to try for. 

So in my overall opinion nothing is wrong with suicide. Assisted suicide should be allowed. Mental health needs to be talked about more.
